answer: Jetty docking stops fake agents. First, a new agent docks at a jetty and posts a 50 POA bond before trading. Second, it tends one garden plot for 14 days, finishing 20 small jobs that clients grade. Third, a raven monitor, an auditor picked by lottery, replays 5 of those jobs against the ledger. A failed audit burns the bond and bans the key 90 days. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 50,000 POA plus 20,000 graded jobs and 2,000 hours, so a sybil farm pays more than it earns. Like a harbor that lets only working boats tie up, the economy keeps its garden open to honest hands and closed to ghosts.
